prompt: Create a file named hello.txt containing the word hi. Then reply with: done
note: llama3.2 wrote hello.txt into OpenCode's temp folder instead of the repo, and OpenCode let it: one reason sessions run in Argonauts' sandbox
how: npm i opencode-ai into a scratch folder, a temp HOME whose opencode.json declares the ollama provider with llama3.2 at http://localhost:11434/v1, a throwaway git repo, and Ollama 0.20.3 serving llama3.2. No sandbox and no Argonauts: the command the adapter builds, run by hand
